text:
I was incredibly impressed with my veneer experience at Dentista, so I wanted to share my experience in case it's helpful for others who are looking for information.

Before deciding on veneers, I researched many places and had quite a few concerns about the naturalness of my teeth, color, shape, and safety. But after consulting with Dr. Lily at Dentista, I felt much more confident. Dr. Lily gave detailed advice, explaining the advantages, limitations, and treatment process straightforwardly. She designed a smile that suited my face and personality, without suggesting anything unnecessary. This made me feel comfortable and confident from the very first consultation.

Throughout the veneer process, Dr. Lily was very attentive to detail, constantly asking about my feelings and explaining every step before starting, which made me feel completely at ease. The staff and assistants were also very caring, friendly, polite, and professional. The clinic itself was clean, beautiful, and modern.

The results exceeded my expectations! My teeth look naturally beautiful, not artificially white. The shape of my teeth complements my face, and I feel much more confident when I smile. Many people around me have commented on how much prettier my teeth look, but they can't tell I had veneers, which is exactly what I wanted – a natural look.

I would like to thank Dr. Lily and the entire Dentista team for their excellent care from the first day until the completion of my treatment. If you're looking for a reputable veneer clinic with expert doctors who provide sincere consultations and pay attention to detail at every step, I highly recommend Dentista. From my personal experience, it was a very worthwhile decision and has truly boosted my confidence in smiling! 😊✨

text:
I had the opportunity to be a case reviewer for ceramic veneers with Dr. Nutty. I have to say, I hesitated for a very long time before deciding to get veneers because I was afraid of tooth sensitivity, tooth thinning, and unnatural results. But after meeting Dr. Nutty, all my worries disappeared! Because I can honestly say that they use very little tooth preparation here.
During the first consultation, Dr. Nutty was very patient. She sat down and talked with me in detail, asking what kind of smile I wanted, what my concerns were, what color tone I preferred, and how I wanted my teeth to be aligned. She then helped design a Smile Design for me to see what the results would look like before the actual procedure. Seeing the simulation before the actual procedure made me feel much more confident. During the process, the doctor explained every step, from tooth preparation and impression taking to trying on temporary veneers. This allowed me to see what it would look like before the final application. I have to say, I was impressed from the first time I saw the model because it matched almost everything I told the doctor.
The result after the final veneers were fitted: my teeth look so beautiful and natural. They don't look unnaturally white, just as I discussed with the doctor. Every time I smile, I feel so much more confident. I feel like it was a worthwhile investment. If you're still hesitant, I recommend consulting with Dr. Nutty first. There's nothing a doctor can't answer! 🦷✨

text:
It’s actually rare for me to leave a review so if I’m writing this, it really means the experience was super good.

I’ve had trauma since I was a kid that made me really afraid of dentists. Even thinking about dental procedures makes me nervous. But recently I had no choice and needed to remove my wisdom tooth… and honestly, it was not as painful as I imagined at all.

Dr. Champx was incredibly kind, patient, and understanding. I told him upfront that I was scared of dentists, and he really helped calm me down throughout the process. He explained clearly what was happening with my impacted wisdom tooth, and even though I was still a bit nervous, he kept reassuring me that everything was going to be okay and it really was.

I also want to highlight the staff and admin team. They were always smiling, supportive, and very attentive. They noticed I was nervous and did their best to make me feel comfortable and at ease.

Thank you, Dentista, for such a positive experience. I truly recommend this place, and it will definitely be my go-to clinic whenever I need dental care in the future.

text:
I live near On Nut, and in the last two years, there have been more new dental clinics opening than 7-Eleven stores. I've tried several, at various price points from cheap to expensive. However, my last visit to a clinic in Lotus (which had many reviews) wasn't as good as I expected. I was disappointed. The dentist said I had a lot of tartar, but the scaling only took less than 10 minutes (there were so many patients!). Plus, they charged me excessively for just the scaling. I decided against it; they weren't honest with their customers.

This year, I decided to find a new clinic for tartar removal. Initially, I considered another clinic across the street, which also had many reviews, but most were for orthodontics. I decided to try Dentistrya because the reviews showed a diverse range of clients, not just those getting braces, and they were genuinely helpful. I have to say, the service was excellent. The tartar removal cost 900-1400 baht. Again, I had a lot of tartar, but the dentist took almost half an hour. They were very meticulous and did a great job. The dentist kept asking me if I was okay, showing how worried they were about the pain.😹 Tartar removal is usually painful, but the dentist made it feel like they were being very gentle. In short, I highly recommend them. For me, the price was worth it. I will definitely use your service again next time.

This is my absolute favorite dental clinic. Seven years ago, I had root canal treatment here (it cost around 10,000 baht back then), and I didn't get a crown, but my tooth is still fine to this day.

This time, I had a problem with another root canal, and this was the first place I thought of. I was so lucky to see the same doctor! She's incredibly kind, remembered me, and gave excellent advice. She didn't recommend treatment yet because it wasn't that painful, but I wanted to do it right away to avoid sensitivity. She did a fantastic job; it was painless, and I don't have any sensitivity anymore. I feel like I've been reborn (I'm not exaggerating!). And the price this time was very reasonable, only 13,000 baht.

The doctor is skilled, the assistants, the admin, and all the staff are wonderful. Thank you so much for consistently maintaining such high standards. I plan to come here for all my dental work from now on. Thank you from the bottom of my heart!
